job.title: Software Engineer, Discovery UX
job.pay_full: $153,120 – $196,750 a year starting base pay (San Mateo headquarters), plus equity and benefits

details.about: Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn and connect in 3D experiences made by its community of developers and creators. The Discovery UX team builds the frontend features on discovery surfaces such as Home and Search, helping users find games they'll love and helping developers find their audience. Engineers design, build and measure their own features.
duties: Design, build and ship features that shape the discovery journey for millions of users
Improve the user experience through rigorous A/B testing and deep analysis of experiment results
Work with teams across Roblox to keep the experience coherent across web and app
needs: 1–3 years of industry experience building web or mobile applications with technologies such as React, TypeScript and JavaScript
A passion for understanding users and creating great experiences for the community
Flexibility to work on backend systems and data infrastructure when a project needs it
An analytical mindset: anticipating edge cases and using data to understand the impact of your work
Respect for teammates and a commitment to a collaborative, inclusive environment
details.benefits: Starting base pay $153,120 – $196,750 a year for roles based at the San Mateo, CA headquarters; actual pay depends on background, training, experience, location, business needs and market demand. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and benefits.
notes: Office-based roles are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, with Monday and Friday optional
Roblox may not be able to employ candidates whose US work authorization is tied to certain visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship, for this role
Reasonable accommodations are available during recruiting
